title: SE implementation scratchpad - Willow Bay Bank
content:
OBJECTIVE:
Quick scratchpad for Willow Bay Bank private deployment runbook, config notes, and outstanding action items. Keep rough; this is my personal working doc for SE tasks + handoff notes.

CONTEXT / CUSTOMER SUMMARY:
- Customer: Willow Bay Bank (regional bank, fintech-adjacent)
- Primary constraint: EU data residency + customer wants Private deployment inside their AWS account (eu-west-1) with optional on-prem HSM for keys.
- Timeline: pilot infra ready by 2026-03-15; production readiness target 2026-04-01.
- Contact: Ana Moretti (IT ops), CTO: Daniel K.

HIGH-LEVEL ARCHITECTURE DECISIONS (agreed in call 2026-02-24):
- Deploy Redwood Private control plane in customer VPC (BYO infra), control plane components run in dedicated subnets.
- Use customer KMS (AWS KMS with custom key in eu-west-1). HSM option deferred to post-pilot.
- Model serving: dedicated pool in customer's account for prod; pilot will use smaller instance types (g4dn.xlarge -> then scale to p4d/p4de for throughput).
- Network: VPC peering NOT required; all infra in customer's VPC. We need to ensure outbound connectivity to Redwood control-plane-monitoring endpoint (for billing telemetry) - will negotiate minimal egress.

QUICK CONFIG NOTES / VALUES (placeholders):
- AWS account id: 987654321000 (placeholder; confirm)
- VPC id: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
- Private subnets: subnet-0aa111, subnet-0bb222, subnet-0cc333 (multi-az)
- KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:987654321000:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
- Allowed outbound: 52.23.45.0/24 (redwood telemetry), port 443 only (confirm CAE)
- Management bastion (jump host) - small t3.micro in mgmt subnet (SSH key: willow-prod-bastion)

NETWORK / FIREWALL checklist (notes to self):
- Need SG rules: allow inbound from load-balancer -> serving nodes: TCP 8080 (internal), 50051 (gRPC) ; metrics port 9090 from mgmt-only CIDRs.
- Ensure NAT gateway for private subnets to pull container images from ECR (or use VPC endpoints). Prefer: create ECR VPC endpoint + S3 endpoint to avoid NAT egress costs.
- Add outbound allowlist for our observability endpoint: telemetry.redwood.ai:443 (customer wants specific IPs; provide ip ranges to security: 52.23.45.0/24, 34.195.0.0/16 - need to confirm exact ranges with infra team).

DEPLOY STEPS (pilot):
1) Preflight (today): collect final AWS accountid, VPC & subnet ids, IAM contact, KMS key arn.
2) Generate terraform vars file for customer (secrets templated): redwood.tfvars -> contains account_id, vpc_id, subnets, kms_key_arn, image_repo
3) Run terraform plan in staging account under RBAC user: terraform plan -var-file=willow-bay.tfvars
4) Apply with customer-approved service account (IAM role cross-account) and run smoke tests (healthcheck endpoints + sample generation).
5) Model pinning: pin to redwood/llama2-13b-q8_0 for pilot; deploy canary with 5% traffic -> rollback to openai-compatible small model on failure.

SAMPLE terraform var snippet (for my notes):
- aws_account_id = "987654321000"
- vpc_id = "vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h"
- private_subnets = ["subnet-0aa111","subnet-0bb222","subnet-0cc333"]
- kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:987654321000:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"

SMOKE TESTS / VALIDATION (short):
- curl -k https://<internal-lb>-health:8080/health -> expect 200
- quick generation test: POST /v1/generate with short prompt -> ok, assert latency < 800ms (pilot target)
- verify token accounting: run 100 requests and confirm usage records in console map to tokens observed locally

ROLLBACK PLAN (simple):
- Canary fails -> automated rollback to pinned fallback model (redwood/llama2-7b-compat) via rollout controller (docs: console-and-rollouts/how-rollouts-work)
- If infra-level issue -> scale down serving replicas, route traffic to hosted fallback (customer approved temporary hosted redirect) -> requires signed approval (Ana).

OUTSTANDING QUESTIONS (to resolve with infra/security):
- Exact outbound IP ranges for telemetry (need Redwood infra team to confirm list). @Priya to request updated allowlist.
- HSM timeline: Willow wants HSM option - is there a templated HSM integration doc? (Mariana to surface previous HSM runbook)
- Backup retention policy for KV cache / checkpoints - default is 7 days; customer asked for 90-day retention. Need cost estimate.
- Do they require private console (control plane) in their VPC or is a customer-managed bastion + MFA acceptable? Security is leaning to private console.

ACTION ITEMS (owner / due):
- Jordan: finish terraform var template + create PR in private-deploy (due 2026-02-27) -- DONE (local branch ready)
- Priya: confirm exact telemetry egress IP ranges from infra (due 2026-03-03)
- Mariana: locate HSM integration doc and paste summary w/ risks in confluence (due 2026-03-05)
- Liam: run cost projection for moving from g4dn.xlarge -> p4d per model for throughput baseline (due 2026-03-01)
- Ana (customer): provide final AWS account id + contact for IAM cross-account role (asked in email 2026-02-24)

MEETING NOTES (2026-02-24 call):
- Ana: "Need to ensure no data leaves eu region." Confirmed: all storage & key material in eu-west-1.
- Daniel: asked about support SLAs for Dedicated pool - promised enterprise docs, follow-up with sales for contract clause.
- Agreed to pilot in staging env first; production after 2-week validation window.

TEST PLAN (pilot -> prod):
- Pilot (2 weeks): functional checks, latency testing, cost baseline, security review.
- Validation: pass 1000 requests/day for 7 days without >1% errors.
- Prod rollout: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 48 hours with automated health checks.

TROUBLESHOOTING NOTES (commands to remember):
- Check pods: kubectl -n redwood get pods
- Tail logs: kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/serving --follow --since=10m
- Port-forward health: kubectl port-forward svc/serving-lb 8080:8080
- Terraform apply with assume-role: AWS_PROFILE=se-willow terraform apply -var-file=willow-bay.tfvars

NOTES TO SELF (personal):
- Keep this doc lightweight; transfer to confluence only the finalized runbook.
- Save TF state in remote s3 bucket with kms encryption (bucket: wb-redwood-tfstate-eu)
- Sync with Legal on data processing addendum before any prod traffic.

RECENT CHANGES / LOG (small):
- 2026-02-25: added kms_key_arn and subnets after call
- 2026-02-27: branched private-deploy/willow-bay; added initial tfvars template
- 2026-03-02: updated action item owners after sync w/ Priya

-- end of scratchpad --
